components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. The value is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; an explicit
            leading '+' and country code are kept, otherwise country code '+61'
            is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national
            digits. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+' and is
            stored and returned in that canonical form (e.g. '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '0412 345 678'
          x-field-extra-annotation: |-
            @jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank
            @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.TelephoneValidation
        email:
          title: Email
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional, but when present it
            must be a syntactically valid address; the value is stored and
            returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.Email"
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials

              readOnly: true

I implemented the duplicate-household rule for `POST /api/owners`, mirroring the existing "duplicate telephone" pattern already in the codebase.

**The rule:** creating an owner is rejected with **409 Conflict** when another owner has the same `lastName` *and* the same `address` — compared case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace — unless the request sets `sharesHousehold: true`.

**Changes:**

1. **`openapi.yml`** — Added a write-only `sharesHousehold` boolean (default `false`) to the `OwnerFields` schema, so it's deserialized from the request but never persisted or returned. DTOs regenerate from this at build time.

2. **`model/Owner.java`** — Added a `@Transient boolean sharesHousehold` field with getter/setter (MapStruct maps it from the DTO automatically; `@Transient` keeps it out of the DB).

3. **`service/DuplicateHouseholdException.java`** — New runtime exception, parallel to `DuplicateTelephoneException`.

4. **`service/ClinicServiceImpl.java`** — In `saveOwner`, for a new owner that didn't opt in via `sharesHousehold`, it checks existing owners for a matching normalized (`trim` → collapse `\s+` → lowercase) last name and address, throwing `DuplicateHouseholdException` on a hit. I applied the case-insensitive/whitespace normalization to **both** `lastName` and `address` (the parenthetical most naturally attaches to `address`, but normalizing both is the more robust reading for duplicate detection and is a superset that keeps all tests green and avoids H2 case-sensitivity pitfalls).
